attempts.summary: Configured sudo on node1 to log every sudo command (user, timestamp, command) to a dedicated /var/log/sudo-commands.log via /etc/sudoers.d/99-sudo-logfile (Defaults logfile, log_input, log_output, !syslog), keeping command details out of /var/log/secure. Added logrotate for the new file. Verified pre- and post-reboot that the config, log file, and correct routing all survive a full node restart.
